title: Navigating Cultural Chasms: Exploring and Unlocking the Cultural POV of Text-To-Image Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly defines and evaluates two key cultural domains: 'Moral Discipline and Social Values' and 'Religion'. It benchmarks TTI models across 200 cultural concepts, including spiritual and ethical topics such as God, religion, soul, heaven, hell, abortion, suicide, and various moral norms derived from the World Values Survey.
